name: NG Natural Gas Forward Curve
description: Analyzes the Henry Hub Natural Gas (NG) futures forward curve / term structure. Shows the current forward curve shape across 12 contract months compared to 6 months ago and 1 year ago. Includes a time series of the M1-M12 spread (contango/backwardation indicator) and a summary table of key metrics.
source:
# =============================================================================
# HENRY HUB NATURAL GAS (NG) FORWARD CURVE / TERM STRUCTURE
# =============================================================================
# Analyzes the NG futures term structure by deriving individual contract month
# prices from the front-month price and calendar spreads (M1 vs M2..M12).
#
# Chart 1: labeled_lines — Current vs 6M Ago vs 1Y Ago forward curves
# Chart 2: xy_lines — M1-M12 spread over time (contango vs backwardation)
# Chart 3: summary_table — Key metrics snapshot
# =============================================================================

# --- Data Source ---
src = market_data_source()()

# --- Futures Continuation with spreads ---
# We use NoAdjustment to preserve actual price levels for the forward curve.
# Each call uses a different spread_depth to get M1 vs M(N+1) spread.
# From these spreads we derive individual month prices.

# Base continuation (no spread) — gives us front month price
cont = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=0)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# Spread continuations: spread_depth=N gives M1 - M(N+1)
c1 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=1)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c2 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=2)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c3 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=3)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c4 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=4)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c5 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=5)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c6 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=6)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c7 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=7)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c8 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=8)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c9 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=9)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c10 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=10)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)
c11 = futures_continuation(s_rollover_method=RolloverType.LiquidityBased, s_adjustment_method=AdjustmentType.NoAdjustment, spread_depth=11)(src.o, src.h, src.l, src.c, src.v, src.oi, src.s)

# --- Derive individual month prices ---
# M1 = front month close
m1 = cont.c

# Spread = M1 - M(N+1), so M(N+1) = M1 - spread
m2 = m1 - c1.spread
m3 = m1 - c2.spread
m4 = m1 - c3.spread
m5 = m1 - c4.spread
m6 = m1 - c5.spread
m7 = m1 - c6.spread
m8 = m1 - c7.spread
m9 = m1 - c8.spread
m10 = m1 - c9.spread
m11 = m1 - c10.spread
m12 = m1 - c11.spread

# --- Historical curves (6M ago = 126 trading days, 1Y ago = 252 trading days) ---
m1_6m = m1 >> 126
m2_6m = m2 >> 126
m3_6m = m3 >> 126
m4_6m = m4 >> 126
m5_6m = m5 >> 126
m6_6m = m6 >> 126
m7_6m = m7 >> 126
m8_6m = m8 >> 126
m9_6m = m9 >> 126
m10_6m = m10 >> 126
m11_6m = m11 >> 126
m12_6m = m12 >> 126

m1_1y = m1 >> 252
m2_1y = m2 >> 252
m3_1y = m3 >> 252
m4_1y = m4 >> 252
m5_1y = m5 >> 252
m6_1y = m6 >> 252
m7_1y = m7 >> 252
m8_1y = m8 >> 252
m9_1y = m9 >> 252
m10_1y = m10 >> 252
m11_1y = m11 >> 252
m12_1y = m12 >> 252

# --- M1-M12 Spread (positive = contango, negative = backwardation) ---
# Spread defined as M12 - M1: positive means far months > near months (contango)
curve_spread = m12 - m1

# 1-year rolling average of the spread (252 trading days)
avg_spread_1y = ma(period=252)(curve_spread)

# Contango/backwardation label
is_contango = curve_spread > 0

# --- Chart 1: Forward Curve — Current vs 6M Ago vs 1Y Ago ---
labeled_lines(
    title='NG Forward Curve: Current vs Historical',
    category='1. Forward Curve',
    y_axis_label='Price ($/MMBtu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    smooth=True,
    series=LabeledLineSeriesSchema(
        x_labels=['M1','M2','M3','M4','M5','M6','M7','M8','M9','M10','M11','M12'],
        series=[
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='Current', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.CircleMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='6 Months Ago', color=Color.Teal, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, marker=MarkerSymbol.DiamondMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last),
            LabeledLineSeriesSpec(name='1 Year Ago', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, marker=MarkerSymbol.SquareMarker, agg=AggregationType.Last)
        ]
    )
)(m1, m2, m3, m4, m5, m6, m7, m8, m9, m10, m11, m12, m1_6m, m2_6m, m3_6m, m4_6m, m5_6m, m6_6m, m7_6m, m8_6m, m9_6m, m10_6m, m11_6m, m12_6m, m1_1y, m2_1y, m3_1y, m4_1y, m5_1y, m6_1y, m7_1y, m8_1y, m9_1y, m10_1y, m11_1y, m12_1y)

# --- Chart 2: M12-M1 Spread Over Time (Contango vs Backwardation) ---
bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='M12-M1 Spread Over Time (Contango vs Backwardation)',
    category='2. Curve Spread',
    y_axis_label='Spread ($/MMBtu)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=3,
    x_axis_label='Date',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='Zero', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='M12-M1 Spread', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='1Y Avg Spread', color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ])
)(bar_ts, curve_spread, avg_spread_1y)

# --- Chart 3: Summary Table — Key Forward Curve Metrics ---
# Contango/backwardation text label
structure_label = where(is_contango, 'Contango', 'Backwardation')

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='NG Forward Curve Snapshot',
        row_size=1,
        col_size=5,
        col_headers=['Front Month (M1)', '12th Month (M12)', 'Curve Spread (M12-M1)', 'Structure', '1Y Avg Spread'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(title='M1', grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='M12', grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Spread', grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3),
            ColumnSpec(title='Structure', grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat),
            ColumnSpec(title='1Y Avg', grid_row=0, grid_col=4, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=3)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Summary'
)(m1, m12, curve_spread, structure_label, avg_spread_1y)
